events.title: Max Amini - Mumbai
events.description: Step into the electric world of comedy sensation Max Amini! Since bursting onto the scene in Los Angeles in 2002, he's captured the hearts of tens of thousands of fans worldwide. Thrilling audiences as a headline act, Max is armed with a fresh array of comedy delights for this extraordinary India Tour that will leave you in stitches and rolling in the aisles! Join us in a hilarious evening as Max unleashes his trademark wit and charm, taking on life’s absurdities and delivering nonstop amusement.

events.title: Haazri - A Homage to Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan!
events.description: Haazri 2026 is a homage to Padma Vibhushan Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, the guiding light who shaped generations of music. For the first time ever, A.R. Rahman, Sonu Nigam, Hariharan, and Shaan will share one stage to pay tribute to their mentor and source of inspiration — a historic constellation of voices aligned in reverence.

events.title: Sunburn Festival 2025
events.description: Asia’s biggest dance music festival returns with a brand-new chapter ~ Sunburn Festival 2025, now taking over Mumbai, Maharashtra for the first time ever!
